questions.question: Explain the difference between energy and power, and define the watt.
questions.expected_answer: Energy is the ability to do work or cause change and is measured in joules; power is the rate at which energy is transferred, energy divided by time. One watt is one joule of energy transferred every second.

questions.question: A hair dryer connected to 230 V draws a current of 6 A. Calculate its power in watts and in kilowatts.
Explain why a kettle has a much higher power rating than an LED light.
questions.expected_answer: A kettle's job is to heat water, which needs a large amount of energy transferred quickly, so its heating element transfers about 2 000 to 3 000 J every second; an LED only produces light and wastes little energy as heat, so it needs only about 5 to 10 W.
